equation_summary: CAT interleaves compressed chunk representations into the decoder sequence. A CATCompressor (separate transformer with block-diagonal FlexAttention) maps each chunk to a fixed-size fx vector; the decoder sequence is [fx_shifted, sep, tokens...] per chunk plus a final [fx, sep]. Decoder self-attention uses the structural mask cat_mask = (compressed_token | within_block) & causal: queries attend causally within their local block AND to prior compressed fx tokens at kv_idx%block_size==0. Architectural tokens (adaptive token, separator, fx) carry token identity; the mask is a fixed structural mask, not a schedule-only chunk substitution.
state_shape: no recurrent state; decoder attends over an interleaved sequence of compressed fx tokens + separator + raw tokens (fixed structural block mask)
normalization: softmax (FlexAttention SDPA) under the structural CAT mask
